atoms.a: The number above the line is called the denominator.
The number above the line is called the numerator.
The number below the line is called the denominator.
Whole numbers can always be represented as fractions with 1 as the denominator.
Fractions are equal to 1 if the numerator and the denominator have different values.
Fractions are equal to 1 if both the numerator and the denominator have the same value.
Fractions with 0 as the numerator have the value 0.
